meta.name: Powerless
meta.description:
Emily Locke lands her dream job as Director of Research and Development for Wayne Security in Charm City, home to super heroes and villains and citizens fed up with the collateral damage of their constant fighting.

Rated TV-PG · Canceled · First aired 2 Feb 2017 · United States · Language: English · 22 min
Studio: Ehsugadee, BQ Productions, Warner Bros. Television · Network: NBC

Complete series. On your server: S1 9/9

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Wayne or Lose
videos.overview: A woman begins her new job with a company specializing in products that make everyday citizens feel safer around damage caused by super heroes and villains that live amongst them.

videos.title: Wayne Dream Team
videos.overview: With a new product idea greenlit, Emily tries to get her team inspired but can't seem to break through their obsession with Fantasy Super Hero League. Meanwhile, Van is on a mission to be included in the Wayne Dream Team photo.

videos.title: Sinking Day
videos.overview: Emily deals with Van stealing credit for her generosity at the office. Teddy pushes a reluctant Ron to get his new invention, a thought-controlled flying drone, to the public

videos.title: Emily Dates a Henchman
videos.overview: After being urged by her team, Emily sets her sights on the dating world but unknowingly falls for one of the Riddler's henchmen. Meanwhile, Teddy and Ron find a Batman artifact and discover Van's superhero fantasy.

videos.title: Cold Season
videos.overview: Emily convinces Teddy to enter what she thinks is a game-changing invention into the Wayne Innovation contest against the elitist engineers of Wayne X, even though he has his doubts. Meanwhile, Van takes advantage of Ron's good nature and has him assemble a toy in hopes of preoccupying his new girlfriend's child.

videos.title: I'ma Friend You
videos.overview: When Emily learns that Jackie is in need of some extra cash, she can't help but try and do what she can to help her out. Meanwhile, Van is on a witch hunt and has his eyes set on Teddy, Ron and Wendy.

videos.title: Van v Emily: Dawn of Justice
videos.overview: When Emily has to put up a fight to get her own office, she challenges Van to a competition. Meanwhile, after Teddy's life is saved by Green Fury , he goes to great lengths to see her again.

videos.title: Green Furious
videos.overview: Emily takes a stand in her first board meeting and must deliver on a big idea with the help of superheroine Green Fury. Meanwhile, Teddy tries to find a way to get Green Fury's attention. Elsewhere, Jackie brings her daughter to work but starts to get worried when she bonds with Wendy.

videos.title: Emergency Punch-Up
videos.overview: In need of some real R&R, the team gears up to leave for a company retreat when supervillain Dr. Psycho releases a toxic gas in Charm City. Now stuck in the Wayne Security offices, Emily does her best to make the most of a terrible situation.

meta.slogan: It's a superhero's world. We just live in it.
